title: Use GPT Image 2 to generate a series of storyboard frames to plan each scene…
content:
Use GPT Image 2 to generate a series of storyboard frames to plan each scene before animating.  
Import the storyboard images into nadou_pro and use Seedance 2.0 to animate them into a final cinematic video.
